entities.summary: William Franklin Shuster is an American politician and lobbyist who served as the U.S. representative for Pennsylvania's 9th congressional district from 2001 to 2019. He is a member of the Republican Party, and is a son of former Congressman Bud Shuster. Bill Shuster was a performers & entertainers from McKeesport (b. 1961-01-10, McKeesport). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
